integration: Turns 1–5 use matching Vortex Putt-Putt event art. An uncanceled Chaos-at-6 surge overrides the turn art with the Stage 2 chaos image; a possum-canceled surge retains the normal turn illustration.
direction: Wide 3:2 roadside-pulp action vignettes matching the approved Stage 1 newspaper illustrations and Stage 2 pink cardboard mini-golf world. Coral sunset, swamp teal, raspberry, cream and mint spectral light; weathered gouache and heavy ink. No readable text, UI, watermark or people.

assets.subject: The crooked pink-and-teal windmill's blades spin violently in perfectly still air, making mint spectral arcs while nearby palms remain motionless and loose golf balls begin to lift
assets.composition: Wide 3:2, low dramatic view, windmill and impossible spinning blades dominate, recessed green leads toward the glowing tunnel
assets.constraints: No people, readable text, logos, UI, watermark, photorealism, glossy 3D, or ordinary windy palms
assets.review: Accepted: impossible blade motion is the clear focal action, the still course remains readable, and no unwanted text or people appear.

assets.subject: A battered mini-golf ball return erupts like a cannon, blasting haunted dimpled golf balls with short mint ghost tails across the pink platform
assets.composition: Wide 3:2 action diagonal, ball return foreground, readable individual ghost-ball silhouettes, windmill and clubhouse behind
assets.constraints: No people, readable text, logos, UI, watermark, photorealism, glossy 3D, bowling balls, or sports stadium
assets.review: Accepted: dynamic ball-return eruption, readable haunted-ball silhouettes, distinct composition, and no unwanted readable text.

assets.subject: The single recessed mini-golf green buckles upward in broken waves, torn turf and cardboard layers exposing an eerie mint void beneath while one golf ball balances at the edge
assets.composition: Wide 3:2, ground-level central upheaval with radiating cracks, windmill tunnel visible at the far end
assets.constraints: No people, readable text, logos, UI, watermark, gore, photorealism, glossy 3D, ordinary earthquake street, or multiple holes
assets.review: Accepted: clearly reads as one mini-golf green splitting over a mint void rather than reused parking-lot damage.

assets.subject: Hole 18 itself wakes up: the recessed putting lane curls like a tongue toward the viewer, the crooked windmill leans forward, fiberglass obstacles twist, and haunted balls swarm
assets.composition: Wide 3:2, one coherent mini-golf hole transformed into a living contraption, dramatic converging perspective and clear silhouettes
assets.constraints: No people, readable text, logos, UI, watermark, gore, photorealism, glossy 3D, crowded amusement park, or multiple golf holes
assets.review: Accepted targeted retry: course geometry comes alive without gators, flamingos, monster faces, or multiple holes. The rejected first render was not copied into the project.

assets.subject: A giant haunted dimpled golf ball with a curling ghost tail hangs over the final green as the windmill tunnel opens into a roaring mint vortex and pulls the course inward
assets.composition: Wide 3:2 climactic low angle, giant spectral ball and glowing tunnel are unmistakable focal points, collapsing pink platform below
assets.constraints: No people, readable text, logos, UI, watermark, gore, photorealism, glossy 3D, planet, moon, or generic fantasy portal
assets.review: Accepted: giant haunted ball and windmill vortex create a clear final-turn escalation without reading as outer space.

assets.subject: A mint spectral cyclone of haunted golf balls, snapped pencils, blank scorecards and arcade tokens explodes around the windmill and ball return
assets.composition: Wide 3:2, central supernatural burst with readable golf debris and course context, distinct from all five turn incidents
assets.constraints: No people, readable scorecard text, logos, UI, watermark, gore, photorealism, glossy 3D, alligators, or generic paperwork office
assets.review: Accepted: whole-course cyclone is visually distinct from the Turn 2 ball-return blast and contains no gators or office filing imagery.
